system.description:
Secret (tome).

Study: an arcane caster with 9th-level spells, or a Necromancer of 15th level or more; 12 weeks, DC 20.

Teaches: the lich's rite (Necromancer, Lichdom): phylactery, poison and ritual, with its benefits and drawbacks. A Necromancer may take it from 15th level instead of 20th.

Upkeep: once a year the lich feeds its phylactery one soul, a creature of Level 5+ it killed and caught with Soul Bind, in a 1-hour rite at the phylactery.

  • Each missed year the phylactery starves and a destroyed body reforms in 1d10 weeks instead of days; after 3 missed years it goes dark, and the next destruction of the body is true death.
  • One soul per missed year restores it.
  • Every soul fed is one the Raven Queen is owed.
  • The Sorcerer King's own tome, taken from his archives in Nulmar, City of Mists, and stolen and sold on more times than anyone can trace.
  • It holds the spell that drowned Syliamyr and the rite of undying he wrote before he vanished.
  • Nobody knows whether he used it.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
